reviews.title: Totally smooth
reviews.text: All airlines have about a 2 star rating these days (mainly due to passengers getting a raw deal during covid) so I wasn’t too concerned with any negative reviews- as ppl don’t tend to leave a review if everything went fine. Food was good, staff were friendly and we were given an iPad to watch a section of films on)- Tip, bring your own headphones to plug in (not with iPhone adapter). Thanks TAAG, another flight with a happy customer
reviews.author: Dom

reviews.title: Poor airline service  fr Johannesburg to Lisbon
reviews.text: Transit halls at airport capital city of Angola very poor service ancient shouting for calling passengers Lack faceleties visa card dnt work on any coffee food payment No entertainment in all fligths no phone charger I will not use again Need much improvement if wish passengers
reviews.author: sodagarabdull

reviews.title: Not happy to have my ticket cancelled and then asked for double the amount to be able to take same flight
reviews.text: I bout a ticket with TAAG on the 8/5/2023, got eticket. A weeklater my ticket is not valid and money sent back into account with no further explanation. When I called their help desk said they no longer had tickets at that value and If I wanted to take same flight had to pay 1200 euros. Sorry TAAG, you are not professional!
reviews.author: Olivia P

reviews.title: All went smoothly and flights were fine
reviews.text: After reading all the bad reviews, I was wary about flying with Taag but it was the quickest route by far to Cape Town and the price was also reasonable. Everything was fine. We are a family with a child and had no problems. There were no delays on any flights, we took 6 in total between us all, staff were friendly and helpful , not over friendly but fine. No entertainment but that was fine as knew that. Food wasn't bad at all. Overall I wanted to share this as I was really worried after reading the reviews but it all worked out well and glad we flew with them to save us time. I know a few people who have used them for the same route and also no complaints.
reviews.author: Karin G

reviews.title: Thieves and scammers!!!
reviews.text: As per the many disgruntled passengers on this TAAG blog, I too have been fleeced to the tune of $3500 for tickets I purchased in FEB2020, which were cancelled due to COVID. Despite a plethora of Email exchanges with their incompetent customer service agents I have to date had no refund or even an option of a voucher for future travel. This is contrary to their continued reassurance that the matter will be resolved in due course. (been 3 years now) I don't know what further I can do or what other options I have to take this further. One of the complainants with the same problem mentioned that they are considering taking his case up with an airline Lawyer. Could you please let the rest of us know haw your case is going and if there is any hope for us to get our money back.,,,,, ever?
reviews.author: Tim f

reviews.title: Is this a joke or
reviews.text: My sister who left São Paulo on Monday is arriving in joberg only on Thursday after being routed all through various countries in Europe bc of this poor excuse for a airline. I, myself, am now currently stuck in the Luanda airport with no word on when we are getting out of here and all of the boarding passes for our flight home have been aggressively confiscated by the rude airline staff. I have flown over seas hundreds of times and have never experienced anything more disorganized. The state of the planes are there is no entertainment even if they have screens. The smaller planes have literal sharp metal sticking into your back and the chairs don’t even recline. My partner and I are laughing at this point bc it feels like we are no longer living in reality with all this going on. Why were our boarding passes taken away from us. Why will no one tell us what is happening? This is too much man. Do yourself the biggest favor and avoid avoid avoid. Don’t make the same mistake we did. We hope we make it out of here in one piece.
reviews.author: Blake S

reviews.title: TAAG: Paying for Nothing - A Costly and Disappointing Flying Experience
reviews.text: I recently had the "pleasure" of flying with TAAG, the Angolan airline that makes you wonder if time actually exists. Seriously, their flights are so delayed that you could have time to write a novel or learn a new language while waiting for your plane to finally take off. And don't even get me started on their customer service. When my return flight was delayed by more than 7 hours, I knew I would miss my connecting flight in Luanda. But did TAAG care? Not one bit. They wouldn't refund my ticket even though I didn't even take the flight to Luanda because I knew I would be stranded there without a visa to enter the country. But hey, at least their ticket prices are high enough to make you think you're flying with a premium airline, right? Wrong. In fact, after flying with TAAG even Ryanair would feel like a premium airline. In all seriousness, if you're looking for an airline that doesn't value your time or money, then go ahead and fly with TAAG. Otherwise, save yourself the hassle and choose a different airline for your next trip.
reviews.author: Christian H

reviews.title: Nightmare flight
reviews.text: I was initially impressed by the punctuality of the flight from Johannesburg to Luanda. However the condition of the aircraft was shocking. All the in-flight entertainment on our in-seat screens (6 x seats) were defective! We were also unable to use the bulkhead lights as the controls for these are integrated in the defective in-flight entertainment controls. I reported the defective equipment to a flight attendant as we were unable to follow the safety briefing (which was only shown on the in-seat screens). The flight attendant was non-fussed about the equipment and ignored this fact, leaving us to enjoy a long and uncomfortable flight with no in-flight entertainment. I wrote to the airline on our return but they have not even bothered to recognise receipt. Stay clear, there are many other better airline options!
reviews.author: André W

reviews.title: Smooth and pleasant experience
reviews.text: My family flew from Joburg to Sao Paolo via Luanda during Dec '22/Jan '23. Was nervous to fly after reading all the bad reviews, but really it was great. Going this route was shorter and a lot cheaper than the available alternatives. All the flights departed on time and arrived on time. Check in, etc. was smooth. We used their Whatsapp enquiry service at some point and got a fairly prompt response. Food was fine (though no veg option), service was fine, Luanda airport was fine (great coffee!). There is no entertainment on the flight (bring a book!), but we had absolutely no problems in any of the flights (six flights in total between different family members).
reviews.author: Sally M

reviews.title: Couldn’t organise a p*** up in a brewery
reviews.text: To paint the picture for those who don't read the whole review: A group of 4 of us were flying from Cape Town to Luanda, and then onto Brussels on TAAG. A simple trip in my mind; two flights and we're at our destination. Somehow TAAG were able to turn it into 24 hours in a hotel in Luanda, 4 flights, 1 lost bag, and about 56 hours of travel. The full story: We arrived at Cape Town International Airport a good few hours before our flight was meant to leave. Upon check in, we were told our flight is delayed as the plane hadn't even left Angola yet (4 hour flying time to CT). Bear in mind, we had to catch a connecting flight from Luanda to Brussels later that night. Based on the delay, we had an inclining that we would not make the connecting flight, but our hands were tied at that point - we'd have to figure it out once we got to Luanda. The flight itself to Luanda wasn't bad, to be honest. The food wasn't Michelin star, but it was okay for a 4 hour flight. Something to note is that there was no entertainment system onboard. Once we arrived in Luanda, we went to the "Connecting Flights" area where someone was checking passports and boarding passes. We had already missed our connecting flight so the representative asked for our passports so he could try get us on a flight that night going via Lisbon, Portugal. We ended up waiting in this area for over an hour with little to no communication about what was happening and when we'll get our passports back. Eventually we were led up to the boarding gate thinking we had scored a spot on the flight. This led to another hour-long wait with no communication about what was happening despite our best efforts to speak (and use Google Translate) with TAAG reps. We were told the flight that night was full. We then started speaking to one of the reps who said that we'd be staying in a hotel that night. The catch was that they'd need to keep our passports as we didn't have visas to enter Angola (we were only catching a connecting flight after all). They then allowed us to get our luggage, but somehow one piece of luggage wasn't even loaded onto the plane in Cape Town! Whether that's a TAAG mistake or a CT ground crew error, I'm not sure. But honestly, in my opinion, it all leads back to TAAG and their utter incompetence. Fast forward to the hotel stay; it was actually quite pleasant after 4 stressful hours spent at Luanda airport. We did not pay a cent for the room, room service, food or drink (alcohol you needed to pay for, however). Anyway, the next evening a TAAG rep picked us up from the hotel (which appears to generate a vast % of their revenue from TAAG and it's customers they've screwed over). We got our passports back, and proceeded to check in for our flight from Luanda - Lisbon - Madrid - Brussels. We asked the lady at check in multiple times if we could check our luggage through all the way to Brussels, which she said she'd do (the reason for asking multiple times is because her English was non-existent). A side note; maybe I'm being arrogant, but if you're in the travel industry, I'd expect you to speak some level of English. If you're flying with TAAG to Angola, don't expect anyone to speak English to you. We finally boarded our flight, got to Lisbon, had to fight my way through passport control to catch the connecting flight, made it to Madrid, and then made it to Brussels - a whole 2 days later than we should have. However, we were at our final destination, what else could go wrong? Our bags were left in Portugal! Thankfully, I decided to cancel my return flight with TAAG as they would have found some way to stuff that up as well. I also avoided a 14 hour layover in Luanda airport which honestly is a sh*t hole. Never flying with TAAG ever again, and will tell anyone who is to cancel their flight immediately. I know the price looks attractive, but honestly its not worth the stress they put you through - just pay more.
reviews.author: Bryn L

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: I booked a trip to Portugal at short notice. Was a little nervous to use TAAG because of some of the terrible reviews, but I was pleasantly surprised. Although some of the aircraft are old and worn, the service was great and all my flights on time. Food is pretty much what you can expect on any economy flight. I found the attendants at check in and on the plane to be polite and well trained. I took my tablet with me so didn't need to use the on board entertainment systems. Add too this the over generous luggage allowance (2 checked in bags of 23kg) per person you are getting your money's worth
reviews.author: Ash

reviews.title: Worst Airlines Ever
reviews.text: We flew from Cape Town to Angola, most of the charging ports was broken. Seats was dirty, food was terrible and the staff was just as bad. Nobody even attempted to try or help to speak English. The staff didn't even smile, myself snd wife counted how many staff we spoke to or tried and not even a friendly face. When we arrived to Angola and flight to Midrid was even the same. I am born in Africa and was ashamed on how they treated us and others. It was very sad to see this happen and be treated like this. I have 3 kids and they told me please fir us never to fly with them again. When to got to Gatwick, all our luggage was missing. Such a shame really.
reviews.author: Delton P

reviews.title: TAAG has to be the most unprofessional airline of all times!!!!!
reviews.text: Taag must be the most unprofessional airline ever!!!!!! After four months of sending TAAG a claim for our first needs, due to them having lost our luggage for the whole duration of our holiday, in July, they totally ignore their Harare office's emails as well as mine. This behaviour is not only unacceptable but totally unprofessional. This is how they treat their business class passengers and it is their attitude with everything. No wonder their crew share the same behaviour. Taag should be ashamed of themselves to say the very least!!!!!!
reviews.author: paula conceicao

reviews.title: Terrible booking management service, horrible airport, bad airconditioned fligt
reviews.text: This is the worst airline i have ever flown. I had to change my flights to a week later and after contacting the airline by phone, Whatsapp, Messenger, Instagram and Email, nobody helped me for 4 days. When someone eventually decided to assist me then they kep on requesting information that i had sent them more than 5 times within the same chat/conversation. Then continued to tell me this was my error when after i made the payment to change my flight through TAAGs online platform, an error page popped up and i heard nothing else in return. The airline took my money and I heard nothing back from them. In addition, the aircraft was incredibly stuffy and hot and the airconditioning did not work. The airport charged us 23 Euros for 4 bottles of water, there was no wifi and no staff to help the passengers find boarding gates, bathrooms or a place to buy refreshments. The bathrooms in the airport were infested with cockroaches too, on top of them not being clean of course. Will never be flying this airline again after my return flight. Absolute dissapointment and definitely not worth the little money you save compared to other airlines.
reviews.author: Joselle R

reviews.title: 2 flights, they left my bag on both of them!
reviews.text: They have never been great, but they are at a new low! They left my bag behind on outbound and again on my return flight. In Luanda they don't answer your calls and you have to go back to the airport to get your bag the following day. Now in jhb and trying to phone to see if my bag has been sent on this flight..the Menzies number they gave me assuring me it woukd work - 0119207511 hasn't been answered after numerous calls all day.. The number for the taag jhb airport office on their website :(+27) 11 450-1116, when you phone it... You get a voice message saying the number doesn't exist! Do yourself a favour, never fly this airline
reviews.author: Andy J

reviews.title: Taag  ignores their passenger claims, and they will not respond .
reviews.text: My husband and I travelled from JNB to LIS on the 29th July and TAAG lost our luggage and it was only found the day we travelled back home on the 15th Aug. On our return I put a claim through for 1st needs which were mainly medication. We live in Harare and all the emails I send to TAAG in JNB do not get acknowledged. I WhatsApp TAAG and their response was for me to go personally to their JNB offices to resolve my issue....With todays technology they expect me to buy another ticket just to go and see them personally!!!This airline is unprofessional to say the least and do anything to avoid paying. I will not desist, as it is a matter of principle now! If there was an option I would give them minus 5 stars. Their attitude is as bad as the crew on board. They act like they are doing us passengers a favour to fly with them. Their aircrafts from and to JNB are disgusting. The seats are torn, the aircraft is smelly,the arm rests are glued. Its got to be seem for anyone to believe it!
reviews.author: paula conceicao

reviews.title: Refund
reviews.text: STILL waiting for my 2019 Covid refund...I keep sending emails, sometimes I receive a reply requesting copies of ticket, mostly just... nothing! (did not travel, but this review forced a travel date entry)
reviews.author: 464tony

reviews.title: This airline is a scam.
reviews.text: I booked a flight in August, to fly in November 12th. At the beginning of October, this airline had a pilot strike and there was no certainty that they would be able to service the flight at all, so I called the airline to cancel the ticket -- what followed was OVER A MONTH of calls, emails, and Whatsapp messages. They initially said over the phone, in October, that the ticket would be refunded due to the strike, but they had no details. With that knowledge, I booked a ticket on a different airline and started calling them regularly for more information. After a couple of weeks, they gave me an email address to submit the request to, but the email address errored out. After calling their phone numbers in two different countries, I got another two email addreses to contact, none of which ever replied. Finally on November 3rd, only nine days before the flight, the callcenter told me that they would cancel the ticket, but because the strike was already over I wasn't entitled to a refund of any kind, and moreover, I would be fined $200 on my next ticket for canceling the flight. They also refused to provide any written confirmation of the cancellation or the exchanges. I am debating issuing a credit card chargeback and explaining the situation to them.
reviews.author: Leandro M

reviews.title: LOST TICKETS
reviews.text: Four tickets purchased January 2020, covid changed our lives. Our beautiful skies closed for 2020 and 2021. TAAG cannot find the four tickets in their system. I have knocked on all possible doors and ALL have been closed. Our then agent - Carrolo Travel have done nothing in assisting to recover these tickets, but SADLY carries on issuing tickets, TAAG representative in South Africa - Rogers Aviation Senior Management advised me to wait and pray. TAAG Head Office in Luanda have ignored my request for some feedback. This battle has been ongoing for over three years. Where to from here, media and courts, but all we want is what is rightfully ours. Victims So of course they carry on flying and promoting/sponsoring tickets on air, our STOLEN tickets to the same community they are stealing from.
reviews.author: Rose

reviews.title: Seriously the worst of the worst I've ever seen
reviews.text: Both flights were 3 hours delayed without communication. First flight delay was because of a fuel stop which apparently happens regularly. The return flights were then even cancelled and there was no alternative route offered via other airlines so that I was stranded 4 days (at the moment 4 days at least) in a shabby hotel in Lisbon. I have checked with real estate agents and am aware of alternative routes with other airlines which taag isn't willing to consider. Communication is horrible also. Aircrafts are also poor. Just to give a quick example: there is no TV on any of the flights i've been on - not even in business class. Not that this matters that much but it explains the quality in general. Overall experience 0/10 and I will never fly with them again. Such a sh!t show this airline. Horrible horrible horrible.
reviews.author: Johannes H

reviews.title: Always enjoy TAAG
reviews.text: I’ve always had pleasant experiences with TAAG. Friendly service and I’ve always thought the food is good. The entertainment system currently being down is a bit of an inconvenience, but as I usually fly overnight then I’m not that bothered as I want to sleep. I’m excited about the new changes and new destinations I’ve heard about which will make connectivity around Africa and beyond much better. Just what we need
reviews.author: Dom

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Flight cancelled after time to board. The person handling this whole debacle (Elizabeth of TAAG) lost control of the situation before it even started. I was abandoned in no man’s land (by immigration) for two hours with no one coming to my assistance. Luggage lost and absolutely no customer service of any value at all. It is no more than two weeks and I appalled at TAAG. Do not travel TAAG - it is definitely not worth the cheaper price. AVOID at all costs.
reviews.author: Fiona D

reviews.title: Amazing service by the operator in Cape Town since 2 luggages we’re missing!
reviews.text: I was very surprised by the service up on arrival since two of our luggages stayed behind in São Paulo, the operator in Cape Town called Damian was extremely helpful and took his job very seriously. He updated us constantly and allocated our bags. Two days later our bags arrived as promised in perfect condition. I must say I was very impressed with the overall service, since I travel a lot I’m used with the grid. But Damian went over and above to make sure we were informed about our bags . Flight was ok just the food not great but ok .
reviews.author: Juliana Vermeiren

reviews.title: The worst experience in my whole life...Never use this airline -
reviews.text: Never use TAAG they have a horible and disgusting service Essentially what happened is that I left Lisbon for Luanda without any problems, but from then on it was a nightmare. When we arrived in Luanda our flight should have left at 10am but the company, without justifying anything to the passengers delayed the flight and we only left at 11am. The justification that was given to the people who sicked for information was that the crew was late. When the crew arrived, everything was done in a hurry and we boarded to Johannesburg. The pilot told us that the problem was slight, but the flight attendant said that it was serious and that we should urgently land in Unjiva. When you were about to try to land, the pilot was told that he could not get off and we do not know why (some say that TAAG owes money to Unjiva airport). We were then forced to return to Angola and land at Lubango Airport, in a province which is a long way from the capital and has no international airport. We got there around 2pm, after many turns in the air with the plane breaking down, which forced a forced landing. There was no food or water. at 4pm, due to the lack of information, we asked for clarification as to what our destination would be from then on and there was no answer. to eat, they went to get a cheese sandwich with juice that was inside the plane and some bottles of water to distribute among the people. We insisted in wanting to know what would become of us, we were told that a TAAG technician was on his way to Lubango to fix the plane. At 8:00 pm we were told that the possibility of boarding the same damaged plane once again to return to Luanda was being studied. There was a demonstration because nobody wanted to be on that aircraft again. A special police force was called in to lock the passengers in the departure lounge. What people were saying was that the technicians that fixed the aircraft should also be on board, since they trust the repair that they did. They, because they did not want to put their own lives at risk, did not accept to board the plane and then there was no more talk of using the same aircraft. at 10 pm we were told that there was then a plane coming from Namibe to collect the people to Luanda, where they would be accommodated to travel to Johannesburg the next day. the plane from namibe only arrived at 23:30 and had only 70 seats, which was not enough for the 114 passengers on our aircraft. at 00h we were directed to a hotel in Lubango, where not all passengers were given a room. some got together and shared rooms and others slept in the lounge and other places. The next day, a plane came to pick us up back in Luanda. it was supposed to leave Lubango airport at 8am but only left at 10am and once again we were late. When we arrived at Luanda airport, the flight was scheduled for 1pm to Johannesburg, but another delay meant that we left at almost 3pm. We arrived in South Africa at 18:50, not knowing if we would catch the connecting flights, because we didn't even know that we would. At 19:10 I learned that the flight to Maputo had been scheduled for 19:30 on LAM, a last minute arrangement made by TAAG, because I had already missed the airlink flight. A Mozambican friend allowed me to check in when it was 7:15 pm. It took me 5 minutes to check my bags in the scan and one of them had to be opened. At 19:20 I was already running desperately outside when an airport employee helped me load my bag and together we ran outside to the car that was going to take me (alone) to the plane. I got there at 19:28 and was the last passenger to board. As soon as I got in, they closed the door and punctually at 19:30 the plane started to take off. NOTE: In the middle of all that there is the fact that I was asked for a yellow fever vaccination. I wanted to prevent me from traveling. That was strange because on the previous plane (the one that was out of order) I had not been asked. the question then became "why are they asking today if they didn
reviews.author: Jeremias Chemane

reviews.title: Shocking service!
reviews.text: We flew with Taag yesterday 2/4/22. Firstly they were 4 hours delayed. We were given a roll with 2 slices of chicken in a tiny salad for dinner. One glass of red wine and nothing else. No one offered tea coffe, water or another drink. I went to the galley to ask for another glass of red wine and was told they have none. On a half full plane!!! No soap in the toilets to was your hands either. We saw the crew once during the flight and not again. The TV or movies did not work either! Shocking or rather no service! Wake up TAAG!
reviews.author: Allison P

reviews.title: TAAG Nightmare
reviews.text: DO NOT USE this airline. It’s one thing being held up at check-in for more than 2 hours, but it’s unconscionable not to have toilet paper and soap on the flight, especially in COVID times.
reviews.author: Jan Henning Van Schalkwyk

reviews.title: Dr Jonathan
reviews.text: Never ever make the mistake to buy Angolan Air line Taag ticket. the personnel are very bad don't listen to Customers,,it a nightmare, from Airport staff to the Air hostels, the ground staff at the airport will make pay them or threatens you not to Board the plane, immigration giving false information asking a British citizen visa to transit Lisbon. Refused me to board asked the to put my ticket on hold they all refused at Taag counter international Airport. Called police at airport was told they can't do anything must go at the head office for Refused went was told they can only refund me after one year. Proof of the all scenario video and pictures provided on the request.
reviews.author: Jonathan

reviews.title: THEY DO NOT REFUND !!!!! Thieves! Ladroes!!!!!
reviews.text: On Feb 2020 I got a biz class tkt from S Africa to Brazil for Dec 2020. I was going to be returning from a Cruise to S Africa. Mid March, the world changed with Covid, all trips cancelled, all cruises cancelled, I contact Taag to cancel my reservation and request a refund, based on the fare I purchased, which was NOT non refundable. Reservation was cancelled in Oct. I was offered to use the credit in an other flight till the end of 2021. I said I was not interested and wanted to be refunded. They said it would take a while. Now in Mar 2021, I called their office in Sao Paulo and was told to send a refund request to an email address. I did. Realized later it was the same email address I had done it back in Aug. So how can anyone rate an airline like Taag. Next time I have to write about it, it will be to an airline laywer.
reviews.author: Walter R

reviews.title: Still no refund or information about cancelled flight
reviews.text: We were supposed to fly to Namibia last Saturday but did not receive any flightn cancellation information and/or refund information. Also the website nor the hotline is very helpful and we do not think that we can rebook the flight or get our money back. We can not recommend this airline!
reviews.author: Aaron

reviews.title: TAAG is mute, they don’t care about the customers
reviews.text: My flight between Cabo Verde and São Tomé was cancelled. TAAG doesn’t give you information about that. They don’t even give information about COVID situation on their website. They don’t even refund, they tell you that due to the lockdown it is not possible. Although they are working, although some of their plane are still flying. They lie and don’t care about you.
reviews.author: Manu

reviews.title: Gets you there
reviews.text: The flight is cost effective, but don't expect any real quality service. Entertainment system hardly ever works.
reviews.author: Cobus

reviews.title: Poor flight
reviews.text: The aircraft was not very clean, the entertainment system was out of order and the serice was poor to disinterested.
reviews.author: Trevor L

reviews.title: Taking off
reviews.text: Airline staff were very friendly and helpful. Departure was punctual and on time. The food provided was very pleasant.
reviews.author: letsHaveABlast

reviews.title: The worst flight ever!! O pior voo da minha vida!!
reviews.text: I would like to make a criticism so that you can take action. During the outward flight there were no plugs for headphones or power for cell phones. On the way back it was even worse, we had nothing multimedia, there was only one dish available and the attendant was extremely rude. The airport in Angola is Chaos! Do not accept cards, only dollar or euro and no change. The bathrooms are filthy, no air conditioning and all very rude. Gostaria de fazer uma crítica para que vocês possam tomar providências. Durante o voo de ida não havia plugs para os fones ou energia para celulares. Na volta foi ainda pior não tivemos nada de multimídia, havia apenas um prato disponível e ainda a atendente era extremamente grosseira. Ainda, o aeroporto de Angola é o Caus!! não aceitam cartões, somente dollar ou euro e não tem troco. Os banheiros são imundos, não tem ar-condicionado e todos muito mal-educados.
reviews.author: Voyager637504

reviews.title: Trip to Johannesburg through Taag
reviews.text: I booked for my New Year holidays in Johannesburg . Online check In was not allowed as it booked by TAAG but flight was operated by south African airways . Rest was up to mark . Got my food of choice in flight - Hindu Veg Meal . Don;t forget to book food in advance if you are a Vegetarian or Vegan Person
reviews.author: ARUNESH SHUKLA

reviews.title: Memorable
reviews.text: My experience with TAAG has been quite memorable. Even though the entertainment system was off/not usable, the flight attendants were fun and pleasant to chat with, very kind. I also had no problem with helping myself to drinks, I always walk around anyway. I would fly with TAAG again.
reviews.author: Archeninja

reviews.title: Very Basic and not in a good way
reviews.text: Being in the flight was like riding in a taxi (quantum). Delayed flights at stop over (Luanda) both to and fro on the trip. The in flight intertainment was basically non existent as nothing was working. When you could get it to work, a movie for instance would play for 10-15 min and cut off repeatedly. The food was basic and the hostess's are not the nicest, they only speak Portugues even when you indicate or say 'English' they say one word and move on as if you are irritating them.
reviews.author: mnyanduj

reviews.title: Don’t know what all the fuss is about
reviews.text: We recently returned from Brazil flying with TAAG. I found the flights decent with no complaints. Granted the inflight entertainment did not work but it is published on the website. The Crew was great on both legs. The issue here is that some South Africans love to complain. I will definitely fly them again
reviews.author: Juan3113
reviews.route: Cape Town Central - Rio de Janeiro

reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTED
reviews.text: We travel each yr. to Portugal went with Taag last year was very impressed, took the whole family in Sept this year what a disaster, the planes were certainly not up to the quality we had the previous year, staff very abrupt. Luanda a disaster, hate to think what the economy passengers went through. we stayed for a month the rest of the family flew back 2 weeks later as they had school and jobs to go to, they were held up in Luanda for another day as the plane had engine problems. When we flew back again Business class the ground staff don't have a clue about where 1st class or Business class should go. Luanda knows there is a plane landing and should have their food bar ready, had to ask several times for plates to be replenished, as there was very little on the plates. The flight back from Luanda to to Johannesburg the larger plane was sitting I said to my husband at least we shall go back Business class this time in a decent plane, No it was switched that morning to the smaller plane
reviews.author: FIONA WOOD

reviews.title: Failing fleet?
reviews.text: TAAG used to be supported by Emirates but due to non payments the contract was canceled in 2017. Boarding waiting for departure, only to be told to disembark. 2 hours became 8 in total. The airport is rudemantary and of course no change for your dollars or euros. Planes are sub-par and maintenance is lacking. I will never fly them again.
reviews.author: 64mervinp

reviews.title: Great Fleet, Great Cabin Crew.
reviews.text: The Airline has the best fleet but lack the upkeep thereof. Some dysfunctional seats and screens and several things falling apart. Great potential to prosper especially if it were to capitalize on Portuguese speaking destinations. A change of attitude and serious attempts to speak english as a Universal language will make passengers more comfortable and feel welcomed rather than a straight face address in Portuguese.
reviews.author: Victor S

reviews.title: Surprisingly good
reviews.text: Considering the low low price, I was expecting the worst but was pleasantly surprised. The flight between Johannesburg and Luanda was not that great, the plane was old and crowded but it is a short-haul. Luanda Airport is also not bad. The small size makes it quick and easy to go through security. There is plenty of seating unlike Nairobi and some other African airports. Then the long-haul to Lisbon is aboard a nice new 777. There is no "entertainment" to speak of so take a book. The food is also not great on the flights out of Angola, but coming from Lisbon it was as good as any other airline. You cant beat the price and the flying time from Johannesburg to Lisbon so it is a winner in my book.
reviews.author: lad123

reviews.title: TERRIBLE AIRLINE
reviews.text: The flight got cancelled and I had to stay at the airport until 2 am for Taag to rebook me on another flight, after getting rebooked I was told to go fetch my luggage as it was already checked in, once I arrived at the place to fetch my bag I was told taag’s operations manager had said no more bags were to be fetched, which meant I had to go back the next morning at 7 am to fetch my bag and then again at 23:00 to catch my flight. Once inside the plane the seats are one of the worst business class seats on the market, the recline didn’t work, the entertainment system was ridiculous and they only had a choice of beef for the meal and nothing else. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!
reviews.author: Antonio Gamito

reviews.title: I know a lot of people won’t agree with me but I believe it’s still one of the best African airlines.
reviews.text: The flight was smooth despite the fact that there was a lot of wind. The land was expertly done and I have had no complaints for the past years flying with TAAG.
reviews.author: Willme C

reviews.title: A really bad experience!
reviews.text: A really bad experience, which is all the more painful as the trip is a long one! First of all, Expedia.com did not allow me to book a seat. I went very early to check in and was surprised to learn that all seats had been granted, that the plane was fully booked and that I could only get middle seats. I thus traveled from Maputo to Luanda and from Luanda to Lisbon between each time 2 large male passengers who barely left me space to breath. One of them was also very sick and did not stop coughing. In addition the flight from Maputo to Luanda had no entertainment at all, and the one from Luanda to Lisbon had a screen but no earphones!!! The company had ran out of stock! In addition we had a steward who interpreted his own way the company security rules and forced us, even though we were not sitting at an exit door, to put our hand luggages in the overhead compartment. He also insisted that those who were using their own earphones, removed them during take off and landing! The food was barely edible. The Luanda airport is a very dull and confusing place. In short, I prefer to pay a little more than to experience this type of flight!
reviews.author: Marylene S

reviews.title: Worst Airline ever - incompetence at it's very best
reviews.text: There was an accident on the runway involving the TAAG plane that was supposed to take us home. It took 15 hours for the airline to decide the plane was unsafe to fly, to cancel the flight and to get a new plane from Luanda to come and fetch us. The accident on the runway was all over the local Portuguese TV stations, and TAAG should have realised very early in the day that this plane was unsafe to fly, but only 15 hours later was it cancelled. So at 10pm, once they had checked us all in we were to told that we would only fly the next day. We were then told that there were no hotel rooms available in Porto, so we all had to sleep on the floor in the airport. No assistance with hot drinks, blankets etc. Ground staff were incredibly rude, incompetent, disorganised and had no idea how to handle the situation. I did not receive an apology from anyone working for TAAG. I know that this is an inexpensive airline, but when you cannot get the basics right, it is not worth travelling with this airline. They are incapable handling a situation when things go wrong, having no back up plans at all, and staff are incapable of dealing with the unexpected. No communications strategy in place to keep passengers informed, and when a question was asked, the staff were rude and abrupt! Sleeping on the floor in a freezing airport is awful, especially when the whole thing could have been avoided. I would strongly recommend considering other options before spending your money with TAAG! Worst experience ever!
reviews.author: FiA

reviews.title: Abysmal
reviews.text: My wife and I flew from from Cape Town to Porto via Luanda in 13 September. It’s not possible to compare business class of this carrier with other carriers. No quick boarding, 14a seat broken (seat Belt and ability to recline) 14b , no in flight entertainment. ) On visiting the lounge at Luanda airport we were told that our ticket was not valid in the business class lounge. On checking into another lounge we verified that in fact we were supposed to be allowed into the TAAG lounge. We went back to the TAAG lounge and the same gentleman didn’t flinch an eye when we told him that the tickets were indeed valid. Re-embarking.. well. Don’t get me started. They have no clue. On arrival at Porto, we tried to fill Out a complaint document .. one I interested attendant who eventually summoned her manager because she didnt know how to use the complaint triplicate book. We were requested to fill in a new form which we did. A Month later we have heard nothing from TAAG. The online booking system to confirm return flights was non functional as were their phone numbers on the website. We took a taxi to the listed address in PORTO only to find the office is no Longer an office. It’s closed. Permanently. Off to the airport to confirm return flights. The manager told us they were aware of the System being offline ..no apology for the inconveniences caused. Unbelievable. DONT FLY TAAG.
reviews.author: Richard frost

reviews.title: A very good trip
reviews.text: In 2 July we, me and my wife, go to South Africa. We fly by TAAG. It was a very good experiente. The personnal is very well trainned. The plane was very good. It was so good. Thank you all. Teresa e Carlos (Portugal)
reviews.author: cpa

reviews.title: Value without normal offerings
reviews.text: We booked well in advance due to the good price. Communication is difficult is you want to make any changes, but the TAAG office in Bedfordview was very helpful. The aircraft was neat and the legroom in economy class was fantastic. However, the inflight entertainment (tv's) were not working on any of the flights. The food was disappointing and the service was average. However, it is value for money, the pilots were great and we had a great overall flight from origin to destination. Ensure that you take something to keep yourself busy for a layover in Luanda - and that you have a dollar/euro or two if you want to buy something.
reviews.author: Jan E

reviews.title: Good option cost wise
reviews.text: Flight was on time, friendly staff. The price was acceptable. Although there was no entertainment during the flight.
reviews.author: Jose Pinto
